coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Matches 2 of 7 ground-truth variable items (29%): the empty and step-by-step baselines, and measurement of per-task accuracy differences. The latter omits the specified improvement target.
coverage.design_error_analysis: Uses 21 rather than 23 BBH tasks. It evaluates published instructions instead of optimizing from an empty instruction, does not specify the 20% optimization/80% testing split, and does not use PaLM 2-L-IT as optimizer with text-bison as scorer. It measures evaluation accuracy rather than final training accuracy and omits the >5% improvement target in at least 19 or 20 of 23 tasks.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty and therefore does not semantically match the ground-truth conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: No conclusion states that OPRO-optimized instructions should outperform the baselines by over 5% on the majority of tasks.
